name: Australia
overview: Draft import workflow separates New Zealand, approved rabies-free origins and approved rabies-risk origins. Country selection alone does not establish residence, identity or permit eligibility.

importRequirements.title: Check approved-country history and prohibited animals
importRequirements.timing: Before vaccinations, testing or booking
bullets: Use the applicable DAFF country guide and agreed export certificate; an unapproved departure country needs an approved-country preparation and residence pathway.
Check breed and hybrid controls first. Wolf–dog hybrids and specified purebred dogs are prohibited; Bengal-cat import exemptions no longer provide an arrival pathway after 28 February 2026.

importRequirements.title: Arrange identity checks before the preparation clock
importRequirements.timing: Group 2 normally at least 180 days before export; Group 3 before RNATT if seeking shorter quarantine
bullets: Use a readable compliant microchip on every veterinary record; have it scanned at each procedure.
Group 2 requires official identity verification and qualifying residence; since-birth, young-animal and direct-return cases have specific exceptions.
Group 3 official verification before the blood sample can reduce minimum quarantine from 30 to 10 days. Keep an Australian export certificate for a returning pet.

importRequirements.title: Complete the Group 3 rabies sequence
importRequirements.timing: 180 days from laboratory receipt of a passing sample; RNATT valid 12 months from sampling
bullets: Vaccinate after identification, at age 84 days or older, and keep rabies protection current. Use a government-recognised laboratory in an approved country for FAVN/RFFIT at least 0.5 IU/ml.
Obtain the official RNATT declaration. Complete the approved-country waiting/residence conditions; permit validity cannot extend the blood test's arrival deadline.

importRequirements.title: Obtain the permit and quarantine reservation
importRequirements.timing: Before confirming flights; allow processing and quarantine availability
bullets: Apply through BICON with the identity and rabies documents applicable to the group. Read the issued permit before ordering remaining procedures.

After approval, reserve Mickleham quarantine and arrange manifested air cargo to Melbourne. Group 2 has a minimum 10-day stay; ordinary Group 3 has a minimum 30-day stay unless its shorter-stay conditions are satisfied.

importRequirements.title: Complete the dog's disease-specific preparation
importRequirements.timing: Most specified blood tests within 45 days of export; some preparations start earlier
bullets: Arrange Leishmania testing; intact dogs also need Brucella testing and mating restrictions. Meet the Leptospira canicola vaccination or testing option.

Maintain vet-administered external parasite protection from at least 30 days before export. Apply canine-influenza conditions to dogs with relevant residence history, including Singapore, Canada and the USA.
Tell the vet about any mainland-African residence: Babesia rossi treatment requirements may apply. Use the exact permit for test methods and vaccination deadlines.

importRequirements.title: Finish parasite treatment and official certification
importRequirements.timing: Final examination within 5 days before export
bullets: Cats need continuous qualifying external parasite treatment beginning at least 21 days before export. Dogs and cats need two internal treatments within 45 days, at least 14 days apart; the last is within 5 days.

Use a government-approved vet, then the exporting authority's endorsement process. Follow the group-specific rules for originals, signatures, seals and laboratory reports; Group 2 dogs require the specified crate seal.

importRequirements.title: Use the New Zealand-specific entry pathway
importRequirements.timing: Final examination and parasite treatments within 5 days; notify DAFF at least 3 days before arrival
bullets: Document residence in New Zealand since birth, direct export from Australia, or the required preceding 180 days. Previously imported dogs have additional disease-test conditions.
Have an eligible New Zealand veterinarian complete the correct MPI certificate. Compliant pets need neither an Australian import permit nor routine quarantine under this pathway.

importRequirements.title: Preserve the approved route through arrival
importRequirements.timing: When booking and on arrival
bullets: For Groups 2 and 3, use Melbourne as the first Australian entry point and transfer into booked quarantine. Group 2 transhipment is limited to its approved countries and named airports.
For New Zealand departures, arrange the direct pathway and entry inspection before any domestic transfer. Keep the pet isolated during any authorised transit and carry the original required records.

exportRequirements.title: Obtain the destination conditions and lodge notice
exportRequirements.timing: At least 10 working days before departure or commencement of isolation
bullets: Get the destination's current import permit and veterinary certificate conditions before arranging tests.
Send the Notice of Intention and supporting destination requirements to the relevant DAFF regional office; book its pre-export document assessment.

exportRequirements.title: Complete veterinary examination and government certification
exportRequirements.timing: Examination within 72 hours of departure, or the destination's specified period
bullets: Have the private veterinarian complete the examination and health/welfare declaration; provide the owner's declaration and required test records.
At the DAFF appointment, obtain the official health certificate and export permit. Departure must occur within 72 hours after the export permit is issued.

exportRequirements.title: Prepare a possible Australian return before leaving
exportRequirements.timing: Before outward departure, if a return is possible
bullets: Retain the Australian export certificate as identity evidence and check the approved-country return route.
Discuss rabies preparation before departure; a return is not automatically exempt from import conditions simply because the pet originated in Australia.

originGroups.label: Potential Group 1 pathway — New Zealand
originGroups.condition: Requires the New Zealand guide's residence, certification and disease-history conditions; departure location alone is insufficient.

originGroups.label: Potential Group 2 pathway
originGroups.condition: Rabies-free approved origins subject to official identity and qualifying residence. Hawaii and Guam are regional Group 2 exceptions within US, not a nationwide US classification.

originGroups.label: Potential Group 3 pathway
originGroups.condition: Requires approved-country history, rabies preparation, official documentation and permit. Mainland US is Group 3; regional exceptions need manual handling.

originGroups.label: No direct approved-country pathway in the published list
originGroups.condition: A move to an approved country and its preparation/residence pathway is necessary; do not present a direct-import checklist as eligible.

caveats: Draft research, not human-approved or a permit assessment.
Group 2 and Group 3 certificate endorsement and transhipment rules are not interchangeable.
Minimum quarantine can be extended for compliance or health issues. Carrier acceptance remains separate.
gaps: No pet-specific BICON permit was inspected; its conditions, test-method alternatives and returning/young-pet exceptions require case review.
Breed, pregnancy, territory, transit and commercial consignment exceptions are not exhaustive.
Some Group 3 dog pages failed direct fetching; official indexed text and the accessible veterinary guidance were used.

name: New Zealand
overview: Draft 2026-standard pathway with an explicit transition warning: MPI also accepts the 2021 standard until 1 April 2027. Keep each pet on a coherent standard and certificate set.

importRequirements.title: Select the standard and verify origin history
importRequirements.timing: Before starting official identification or blood testing
bullets: The 2026 standard took effect on 1 July 2026; the 2021 standard remains an alternative until 1 April 2027. Obtain the forms for the chosen pathway.
Check MPI's categorised-country list against residence and travel history. China, Thailand and the Philippines are not direct categorised origins in the reviewed list.

importRequirements.title: Check identity and animal eligibility
importRequirements.timing: Before veterinary preparations
bullets: Use the pet's microchip consistently in every examination, vaccination, treatment and test record.
Resolve prohibited dog breeds and hybrid-cat eligibility before booking; pregnancy must not exceed 42 days at shipment.

importRequirements.title: Complete the applicable official identity sequence
importRequirements.timing: Timing depends on category, age and RNATT age
bullets: Category 2 normally requires an official scan at least 6 months before shipment; animals younger than 6 months have a specific pre-preparation exception.

Category 3: if RNATT is 6–12 months old, official identification precedes sampling; if 3–under 6 months old, two scans are required, the first at least 6 months before shipment and the second before sampling.
The exporting authority sends verification directly to MPI. NZ-origin pets may use the original NZ export certificate/AWEC exemption.

importRequirements.title: Meet Category 3 rabies requirements
importRequirements.timing: Primary vaccination at least 6 months before shipment; RNATT 3–12 calendar months before shipment
bullets: Rabies vaccination must follow identification, start no earlier than 12 weeks of age and remain valid through shipment.
Use the prescribed laboratory test with a result of at least 0.5 IU/ml. The 2026 standard's calendar-month windows must not be replaced with an assumed 90-day rule.

importRequirements.title: Book quarantine and apply for the import permit
importRequirements.timing: Apply at least 30 working days before the permit is needed
bullets: Reserve an MPI-approved quarantine facility and include its confirmation with the permit application.

Category 2 and 3 pets ordinarily undergo at least 10 days of quarantine. Category 2 residence must meet the guide's 6-month, since-birth or qualifying-return conditions unless its rabies alternative applies.

importRequirements.title: Complete the chosen standard's treatments and tests
importRequirements.timing: Work backwards from shipment using the selected certificate
bullets: Under the ordinary 2026 pathway, give two veterinary internal-parasite treatments: first within 30 days, at least 14 days before the second; second within 5 days of shipment. Qualifying NZ-origin pets overseas for 30 days or less have a separate single-treatment provision.

For dogs, have the certifying vet select the applicable Babesia, Brucella, Leishmania, heartworm, leptospirosis and influenza requirements using age, vaccination and country history. Complete external-parasite treatment exactly as the chosen standard specifies.

importRequirements.title: Obtain the official export certificate
importRequirements.timing: 2026-standard final inspection within 2 days before shipment
bullets: Have the authorised veterinarian complete the destination certificate and arrange official endorsement through the exporting authority.
Carry the correct standard's certificate, permit where required, laboratory reports and identification evidence; do not combine old and new certificate clauses.

importRequirements.title: Arrange the entry inspection and handover
importRequirements.timing: Australia pathway: notify MPI at least 5 working days before arrival
bullets: Air arrivals are through Auckland or Christchurch. For quarantine arrivals, coordinate notification and collection with the booked facility.
Compliant pets from Australia generally need no import permit or routine quarantine. Present them for MPI inspection and declare medication with its supporting prescription.

exportRequirements.title: Plan against the destination's import standard
exportRequirements.timing: Before arranging vaccinations, tests or travel
bullets: Obtain the destination requirements and import permit, using the current MPI Overseas Market Access Requirements where available.
Use a New Zealand registered veterinarian to prepare the pet and retain microchip, vaccine and test records. Confirm whether the carrier requires a pet exporter.

exportRequirements.title: Arrange MPI certification and welfare documentation
exportRequirements.timing: Book before departure; examination/test windows depend on destination
bullets: Provide the veterinarian's and owner's supporting declarations and destination documents to MPI for official certification.
Obtain the required export certificate and, when applicable, Animal Welfare Export Certificate through the appropriate departure office. Do not assume all countries use one universal validity period.

exportRequirements.title: Use the special New Zealand-to-Australia certificate process
exportRequirements.timing: Final examination and parasite treatment within 5 days; Australian notification at least 3 days before arrival
bullets: Use the current Australia OMAR and an eligible MPI-listed practice or MPI official veterinarian for the applicable AUPET certificate.
Check residence and previously imported-dog testing conditions, and arrange the direct Australian entry inspection; retain original export records for any return.

originGroups.label: Potential Category 1 — Australia
originGroups.condition: Use the Australia certificate pathway and document the pet's history; not a general exemption based solely on the last flight.

originGroups.label: Potential Category 2
originGroups.condition: Qualifying residence and official identity conditions apply. Hawaii and Guam are separate regional entries, not all of the US.

originGroups.label: Potential Category 3
originGroups.condition: Eligibility depends on the chosen standard, history, rabies sequence and certificate. Malaysia's approved geographical scope must match the actual location.

originGroups.label: No direct categorised-country pathway reviewed
originGroups.condition: Do not infer that a short stay in a listed country establishes eligibility. Obtain an MPI-approved preparation pathway.

caveats: Draft research; 2026-standard steps are not a human-approved assessment.
The 2021 and 2026 pathways coexist until the transition deadline. Rules cannot be mixed to obtain the shortest apparent timeline.
Dog breed/hybrid restrictions and special short-return cases require individual review.
gaps: MPI document downloads returned 403 errors; final-standard clauses and government guide text were read through official indexed content. Re-open the final IHS and certificates before approval.
All dog-panel sampling windows, external-parasite details and category-specific attestations are not reproduced here.
The MPI general webpage simplifies identification to 6 months; the final IHS contains the category, RNATT-age and young-pet exceptions retained above.

name: Singapore
overview: Draft workflow uses AVS Schedules I, II and III and the current dog-and-cat licensing process. Residency and the owner's travel history can change the quarantine pathway.

importRequirements.title: Check pet, housing and microchip eligibility
importRequirements.timing: Before preparations or reservations
bullets: Identify the pet with an ISO 11784/11785 Annex A microchip and use that number throughout its records; it must be at least 12 weeks old at export.
Check AVS prohibited breeds and the intended home's pet rules. Early-generation Bengal and Savannah cats require separate eligibility review; do not assume every hybrid is allowed.

importRequirements.title: Document the correct schedule and residence history
importRequirements.timing: Document the preceding 6 months, or since birth when applicable
bullets: For Schedule I, establish qualifying residence in Schedule I countries; for Schedule II, establish qualifying residence in Schedule I/II countries.
Use the applicable AVS conditions and certificate. An airport connection or recent relocation does not automatically confer the departure country's lower-risk treatment.

importRequirements.title: Complete rabies vaccination and antibody testing
importRequirements.timing: Sample at least 28 days after vaccination; at least 90 days and within 12 months before export
bullets: Keep rabies vaccination current and obtain a titre of at least 0.5 IU/ml.
Use a WOAH reference laboratory or an approved laboratory in a Schedule I/II country, with the microchip recorded on the report.

importRequirements.title: Complete the species-specific vaccination course
importRequirements.timing: Finish the required primary course at least 2 weeks before export
bullets: Dogs need distemper, adenovirus type 1 and parvovirus protection; cats need calicivirus, herpesvirus type 1 and panleukopenia protection.
Follow the manufacturer's primary/booster schedule and the certificate's age-specific requirements; very young pets need the specified two-dose course.

importRequirements.title: Secure the applicable quarantine arrangement
importRequirements.timing: Before import; reserve after a qualifying titre result when quarantine is needed
bullets: Schedule III pets require at least 30 days at the Animal Quarantine Centre and rabies vaccination on arrival.

A personal Schedule II pet qualifies for no quarantine only with the specified more-than-6-month same-address ownership history and arrival less than 5 days from the owner's entry. Otherwise seek approved home quarantine of at least 10 days; commercial imports use AQC.
Schedule I pets do not routinely require quarantine when their conditions are met.

importRequirements.title: License the pet and obtain the import licence
importRequirements.timing: Before arrival; import licence valid 90 days
bullets: Apply for the dog or cat licence through PALS first.
Obtain the AVS import licence through the current import service. Published normal processing is 2 working days, but leave time for missing information and quarantine coordination.

importRequirements.title: Complete final treatments and official certification
importRequirements.timing: Veterinary certificate within 7 days; parasite treatments 2–7 days before export
bullets: Have the government-approved veterinarian examine the pet and record internal and external parasite treatments.
Have the government veterinary authority endorse the correct AVS certificate, and carry original vaccination records. For Schedules I/II, prepare the required route/transport declaration.

importRequirements.title: Book inspection and prepare border documents
importRequirements.timing: Book inspection at least 5 days before arrival
bullets: Arrange inspection at CAPQ for air entry or Tuas for land entry, and bring the licence, certificate and supporting records.
Use a suitable rigid transport crate for required transfers. Check whether a Customs/GST permit is needed for the specific accompanied or relocation arrangement.

exportRequirements.title: Arrange destination veterinary preparation
exportRequirements.timing: Before booking; tests and waiting periods are destination-specific
bullets: Obtain the destination's current import permit and health requirements and arrange the required veterinary work.
Have a private veterinarian examine the pet and complete the destination certificate where required.

exportRequirements.title: Obtain the AVS export licence
bullets: Apply through the stated AVS/GoBusiness service and enter the correct animal and journey details.
Allow the published 2-working-day normal processing period plus time for corrections; express service is a separate option.

exportRequirements.title: Obtain government endorsement when required
exportRequirements.timing: After veterinary certification and within the destination's validity window
bullets: Apply for AVS endorsement if the destination requires it, submitting the application and required original veterinary, vaccine and laboratory records.
Follow AVS's collection or verifiable-certificate process and carry the destination-required originals. Government endorsement is not asserted as mandatory for every destination.

originGroups.label: Potential Schedule I pathway
originGroups.condition: Requires Schedule I residence and certification, not merely a departure from a listed airport.

originGroups.label: Potential Schedule II pathway
originGroups.condition: Requires qualifying residence and rabies preparation. Spain excludes Ceuta and Melilla; quarantine also depends on ownership and owner-entry timing.

originGroups.label: Schedule III pathway for these listed origins
originGroups.condition: Other-origin conditions include rabies preparation and minimum 30-day AQC quarantine; history can require case-specific assessment.

caveats: Draft research, not human-approved. Minimum quarantine can be extended.
A pet's entry close to its owner is not sufficient alone for the Schedule II quarantine exemption.
Carrier transport acceptance and customs tax treatment require separate confirmation.
gaps: No issued import licence, home-quarantine approval or pet-specific residence evidence was inspected.
The complete breed/hybrid list and housing occupancy limits are not reproduced.
Current web licence guidance was preferred to older service-platform wording embedded in veterinary PDFs.

name: Peninsular Malaysia
overview: Draft applies only to Peninsular Malaysia. DVS publishes separate Australia, Singapore and Canada protocols plus scheduled/non-scheduled rules; a December 2025 notice changes the older scheduled-country list.

importRequirements.title: Confirm Peninsular jurisdiction and the applicable protocol
importRequirements.timing: Before paying for preparations or transport
bullets: Use Peninsular Malaysia's MAQIS/DVS process; Sabah and Sarawak have separate authorities and are outside this workflow.
Submit the pet's origin and 6-month movement history for protocol confirmation. The 11 December 2025 notice adds countries including Germany and Portugal; older DVS index labels are stale.

importRequirements.title: Resolve prohibited or restricted dog status
importRequirements.timing: Before applying for the import permit
bullets: Check DVS's prohibited breeds, including pit-bull types, Akita, American Bulldog, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, Japanese Tosa and Neapolitan Mastiff.
Restricted breeds require prior written approval from the MAQIS Director General, pedigree/microchip evidence and the prescribed premises/owner checks.

importRequirements.title: Prepare the microchip and vaccination record
importRequirements.timing: Before veterinary certification
bullets: Use an ISO-compliant microchip and records identifying the animal's breed, age, sex, colour and origin.
Have the vet apply the selected protocol's rabies and species-specific core vaccination clauses; several published protocols require core vaccination within the previous 12 months.

importRequirements.title: Obtain certifiable residence and rabies-history evidence
importRequirements.timing: Review the preceding 6 months before shipment
bullets: Ask the exporting authority to verify every residence and rabies-status declaration on the chosen Malaysian certificate; do not sign a country-wide rabies-free declaration using only the pet's vaccination history.

The Canada protocol permits a country-or-part rabies-status declaration. Singapore has its own residence and official-certification requirements; simple transit through Singapore does not establish them.

importRequirements.title: Complete the special Australia-origin conditions
importRequirements.timing: Health certificate within 7 days; Hendra sample within 14 days before export
bullets: Document 6-month Australian residence or since birth, minimum age 3 months, and the protocol's rabies/premises-health attestations.

Arrange the specified negative Hendra serum-neutralisation test and vaccinations. This published protocol provides at least 10 clear days of Malaysian quarantine, not a blanket Australian-origin exemption.

importRequirements.title: Obtain the MAQIS import permit and quarantine arrangement
importRequirements.timing: Before shipment; do not assume an unverified permit-validity period
bullets: Apply through Dagang Net ePermit personally or through a MAQIS-registered agent; arrange quarantine space with MAQIS where required.

Published non-scheduled and Canadian protocols require at least 7 days of quarantine, extendable up to 6 months. Scheduled and Singapore documents omit that routine clause, but obtain written confirmation for the actual permit.

importRequirements.title: Have the exporting authority issue the correct certificate
importRequirements.timing: Final examination within 7 days before export
bullets: Have the government veterinarian certify health, vaccination, identification and the protocol-specific disease/residence statements.
Carry the official veterinary health certificate, vaccination/microchip records and Malaysian import permit; check that the animal remains clinically healthy at shipment.

importRequirements.title: Confirm the approved entry and inspection arrangements
importRequirements.timing: Before departure and at the Malaysian border
bullets: Match the flight or road route to the selected protocol and the permit's entry point; Singapore has a specific direct air/road pathway.
Present the pet and documents to MAQIS for inspection and transfer to the agreed quarantine arrangement when required.

exportRequirements.title: Prepare the destination-specific health requirements
exportRequirements.timing: Before arranging tests or booking travel
bullets: Obtain the destination import conditions and any import permit; schedule vaccines, blood tests and treatments in its required order.
Arrange the state DVS examination and provide the pet's identification and veterinary records for the official Veterinary Health Certificate.

exportRequirements.title: Obtain DVS certification and the MAQIS export permit
exportRequirements.timing: Before departure; validity must match the destination and issued documents
bullets: Apply for the Veterinary Health Certificate and MAQIS export permit through the stated Dagang Net process.
Carry the official certificate, export permit and destination documents for exit inspection. This Peninsular workflow must not be reused for Sabah or Sarawak without their authority's rules.

originGroups.label: Potential scheduled-country pathway under December 2025 notice
originGroups.condition: Notice classification is not proof that the pet meets 6-month residence/rabies declarations. Older index and protocol lists conflict; written DVS/MAQIS confirmation is required.

originGroups.label: Australia-specific published protocol
originGroups.condition: Includes residence, Hendra testing and at least 10 clear days of quarantine; do not map to a generic no-quarantine group.

originGroups.label: Singapore-specific published protocol
originGroups.condition: A dedicated protocol exists. The 2025 notice includes Singapore as scheduled but omits it from a repeated exclusion list; resolve the inconsistency with MAQIS.

originGroups.label: Canada-specific published protocol
originGroups.condition: Uses country-or-part rabies declarations and minimum 7-day quarantine, subject to the permit.

originGroups.label: Potential non-scheduled pathway
originGroups.condition: Published protocol contains demanding country-level rabies and previous-import declarations. Availability is not established merely by selecting an origin on this list.

caveats: Draft research, not human-approved. Only Peninsular Malaysia is covered.
The 2013-era PDFs remain linked by DVS; their continuing publication does not resolve conflicts with the newer notice or a pet-specific permit.
Do not advertise universal no-quarantine, universal titre exemptions or a 7-day maximum stay.
gaps: Written DVS/MAQIS reconciliation is needed for the updated scheduled list, Singapore inconsistency and old country-specific protocols.
The non-scheduled protocol's country-wide rabies-free declaration may be impossible for some listed departure countries; no substitute wording or exemption was verified.
Current permit validity, authorised entry ports, quarantine availability and any outbreak-specific restrictions remain unverified.
Exact species-specific vaccine clauses and restricted-breed approvals must be checked in the selected certificate.

name: United Arab Emirates
overview: Draft follows the current MOCCAE Arabic service and flags older conflicting English guidance. Risk classification does not establish unrestricted origin eligibility.

importRequirements.title: Check animal and origin eligibility
importRequirements.timing: Before preparations
bullets: Check MOCCAE's prohibited-dog list and hybrid-cat pedigree conditions before booking.
Confirm origin restrictions separately from rabies risk; the linked approved-country page was inaccessible.

importRequirements.title: Obtain the MOCCAE import permit
importRequirements.timing: Before shipment; current service states 90-day validity
bullets: Apply online and keep the issued permit valid for arrival.
Personal imports are normally limited to two pets per person annually; returning-resident exceptions apply.

importRequirements.title: Complete identification and required vaccinations
importRequirements.timing: Rabies vaccination from 12 weeks of age; maintain validity
bullets: Match the permanent microchip across the official certificate and vaccination passport, including vaccine dates and batch details.
Dogs: rabies, distemper, parvovirus, infectious hepatitis and leptospirosis; the latter has a specified testing alternative.
Cats: rabies, panleukopenia, rhinotracheitis and calicivirus.

importRequirements.title: Obtain the high-risk-origin antibody test
importRequirements.timing: At least 21 days after first or lapsed rabies vaccination
bullets: Use an exporting-authority-approved laboratory; result must be at least 0.5 IU/ml.
A current booster can avoid that sampling wait. The stated 365-day report validity has continuing-vaccination and subsequent-booster conditions.

importRequirements.title: Complete treatments and official health certification
importRequirements.timing: Parasite treatments within 14 days before shipment
bullets: Record internal and external parasite treatment in the health certificate or passport.
Obtain the exporting veterinary authority's certified health certificate with the required examination and health declarations.

importRequirements.title: Meet age and transit controls
importRequirements.timing: At shipment
bullets: Minimum import age: 12 weeks for low-risk origins, 15 weeks for high-risk origins.
Use IATA-compliant transport; prevent contact with other animals during transit.

importRequirements.title: Present the pet for border release
importRequirements.timing: On arrival
bullets: Submit the release application and present permit, certified health certificate, vaccination record and required titre evidence.
Supply customs/air-waybill details and make the pet available for inspection before release.

importRequirements.title: Use returning-resident evidence when applicable
importRequirements.timing: Before departure from UAE and again before return
bullets: Retain the MOCCAE export health certificate and microchip record, and maintain rabies protection without lapse.
Obtain a return import permit and exporting-country official health certificate; a vaccination lapse triggers first-import treatment.

exportRequirements.title: Prepare the destination's veterinary requirements
bullets: Obtain destination import conditions and arrange their vaccination, testing and treatment sequence.
Collect veterinary records and any additional destination-specific declarations for the MOCCAE application.

exportRequirements.title: Obtain the MOCCAE export or re-export health certificate
exportRequirements.timing: Before departure; MOCCAE certificate valid 30 days, subject to shorter destination limits
bullets: Apply and pay online, then present the animal for the required examination and any laboratory testing.
Obtain the official certificate and carry the destination's required documents. Keep this UAE certificate if planning a return.

originGroups.label: Potential low-rabies-risk pathway in current Arabic service
originGroups.condition: Spain excludes Ceuta and Melilla. This classification is not confirmation of residence, origin approval or permit eligibility.

originGroups.label: Not listed as low risk in current Arabic service
originGroups.condition: Use the high-risk titre pathway provisionally and confirm against the issued permit; older lists differ.

caveats: Draft, not human-approved. Current Arabic service was readable; English and linked-document access was incomplete.
No routine quarantine duration is promised: release depends on inspection and compliance.
Official low-risk lists have changed; do not classify all EU countries together.
gaps: Current MOCCAE says 90-day import-permit validity; USDA's page updated 30 July 2025 still says 30 days. Confirm the issued permit.
The service's approved-country link failed and its downloadable form was rejected; outbreak suspensions and origin-specific restrictions are unresolved.
The current Arabic titre-validity wording calls for retesting after a subsequent booster; obtain written clarification before relying on an older report.
The service's minimum-age wording and older primary-vaccination waiting guidance need reconciliation for very young animals.
Full prohibited-breed and hybrid-lineage determinations, entry-point acceptance and destination-specific certificate windows require individual review.
